en.title: Resident directors and nominee shareholder risks in ASEAN
en.standfirst: Local resident director requirements in Singapore, and why a professional nominee director is legally different from a prohibited nominee shareholder arrangement in Indonesia.
en.metaDescription: Resident director requirements in ASEAN, and the legal difference between appointing a nominee director and using a prohibited nominee shareholder structure.
en.body:
For founders researching **resident director Singapore** requirements, the central distinction is between appointing a director and determining who owns the company.

A professional resident director arrangement concerns a board appointment. A **nominee shareholder Indonesia** arrangement can involve prohibited ownership arrangements. Understanding that distinction is essential to managing **foreign ownership restrictions in ASEAN** and **ASEAN corporate compliance**.

The rules must be assessed by jurisdiction. Neither director residency requirements nor the treatment of nominee shareholders should be assumed to be identical across ASEAN.

## The resident director rule

Singapore requires at least one company director who meets its local residency requirements.

For a founder who does not meet those requirements, arranging an eligible director is part of incorporation planning. The relevant question is whether the proposed person satisfies the residency and appointment requirements, not simply whether someone is willing to lend their name.

ACRA's guidance sets out the requirements for directors and other company officers. [ACRA: Choosing company directors and key officers](https://www.acra.gov.sg/register/business/registering-different-business-structures/local-company/appointing-company-directors-other-key-officers/)

## Using professional nominee directors

Professional nominee director services can form part of a Singapore company's arrangements.

However, a nominee appointment does not remove a director's legal responsibilities. ACRA makes clear that all directors have responsibilities under the legislation, whether active in daily operations or otherwise. An indemnity or limited operational role does not remove those responsibilities. [ACRA: Director duties and nominee appointments](https://www.acra.gov.sg/register/business/registering-different-business-structures/local-company/appointing-company-directors-other-key-officers/)

Before making an appointment, establish the director's role, the service arrangements and the applicable disclosure requirements. ACRA is the relevant agency for Singapore company registration and governance guidance.

## The nominee shareholder trap

A nominee shareholder arrangement concerns ownership rather than board membership.

The risk arises when a local person appears to own shares on behalf of a foreign investor to conceal the underlying ownership or circumvent restrictions.

Indonesia's Investment Law prohibits agreements or statements asserting that shares are held for and on behalf of another person in the circumstances covered by Article 33. [Indonesia Ministry of Law: Nominee ownership guidance](https://literasihukum.bphn.go.id/konsultasi-hukum/1257)

That Indonesian prohibition should not be described as a universal ban on every nominee shareholding arrangement throughout ASEAN. Singapore, for example, has disclosure rules for nominee directors and nominee shareholders. [ACRA: Nominee registers](https://www.acra.gov.sg/manage/companies/legal-requirements-common-offences/maintaining-local-companys-information-registers/rond-rons/setting-up-maintaining/)

## The legal consequences

Under Indonesia's Article 33 framework, prohibited nominee ownership agreements are null and void. An investor therefore cannot assume that a private agreement will protect the ownership position it was intended to create. [BKPM: Law No. 25 of 2007 on Investment](https://jdih.bkpm.go.id/id/document/law-number-25-year-2007-on-investment)

The practical distinction remains clear: appointing an eligible professional resident director and concealing ownership through a prohibited shareholding arrangement raise different legal issues.

Confirm director eligibility, ownership permissions and disclosure obligations separately. For Singapore arrangements, consult [ACRA](https://www.acra.gov.sg/); for Indonesian ownership structures, check the applicable investment law before relying on a nominee agreement.

zh.title: 東協的居民董事規定與名義股東風險
zh.standfirst: 新加坡的本地居民董事要求，以及為何專業名義董事在法律上不同於印尼所禁止的名義股東安排。
zh.metaDescription: 東協各國的居民董事要求，以及委任名義董事與使用被禁止的名義股東架構之間的法律差異。
zh.body:
對於研究**新加坡居民董事**規定的創業者而言，核心區別在於：委任董事，與決定誰擁有公司，是兩件不同的事。

專業居民董事安排涉及的是董事會任命。**印尼名義股東**安排則可能涉及被禁止的持股安排。了解這項區別，是處理**東協外資持股限制**與**東協公司合規**的關鍵。

相關規定必須按司法管轄區逐一評估。不應假設董事居住要求或名義股東的處理方式在整個東協都相同。

## 居民董事規定

新加坡要求至少一名公司董事符合其本地居住要求。

對於不符合這些要求的創業者，安排合格董事是公司登記規劃的一部分。真正的問題是擬任人選是否符合居住與任命要求，而不只是有人願意出借姓名。

ACRA 的指引列明董事及其他公司高級人員的要求。[ACRA：選任公司董事與主要高級人員](https://www.acra.gov.sg/register/business/registering-different-business-structures/local-company/appointing-company-directors-other-key-officers/)

## 使用專業名義董事

專業名義董事服務可以成為新加坡公司安排的一部分。

然而，名義任命並不免除董事的法律責任。ACRA 明確指出，所有董事無論是否參與日常營運，都負有法律規定的責任。補償協議或有限的營運角色都不能免除這些責任。[ACRA：董事職責與名義任命](https://www.acra.gov.sg/register/business/registering-different-business-structures/local-company/appointing-company-directors-other-key-officers/)

在任命之前，先確定董事的角色、服務安排及適用的揭露要求。ACRA 是新加坡公司登記與公司治理指引的相關主管機關。

## 名義股東的陷阱

名義股東安排涉及的是所有權，而非董事會成員身分。

風險出現在當地人士表面上代外國投資人持有股份，以隱匿實際持股或規避限制的情況。

印尼《投資法》禁止在第 33 條所涵蓋的情況下，訂立或聲明股份是為他人、代他人持有的協議或聲明。[印尼法律部：名義持股指引](https://literasihukum.bphn.go.id/konsultasi-hukum/1257)

不應將印尼的這項禁令描述為對整個東協所有名義持股安排的全面禁止。例如，新加坡對名義董事與名義股東設有揭露規定。[ACRA：名義人登記冊](https://www.acra.gov.sg/manage/companies/legal-requirements-common-offences/maintaining-local-companys-information-registers/rond-rons/setting-up-maintaining/)

## 法律後果

依據印尼第 33 條框架，被禁止的名義持股協議無效。因此，投資人不能假設私下協議能夠保障其原本想藉此建立的持股地位。[BKPM：2007 年第 25 號投資法](https://jdih.bkpm.go.id/id/document/law-number-25-year-2007-on-investment)

實務上的區別仍然明確：委任合格的專業居民董事，與透過被禁止的持股安排隱匿所有權，所引發的法律問題並不相同。

請分別確認董事資格、持股許可及揭露義務。新加坡的安排請諮詢 [ACRA](https://www.acra.gov.sg/)；印尼的持股架構則應在依賴名義協議之前，先查核適用的投資法。
